head: Disney+ free tier with 24/7 live channels is planned, report says
dek: Disney is planning a free Disney+ plan with always-on channels that carry ads, according to an internal presentation reviewed by Business Insider and reported by Cord Cutters News. Disney hasn't announced it.
details: The deck reportedly describes a "Free Plan and free experience" with ad-supported live channels, where you join a show in progress, and "content sampling" that lets you watch some titles without paying. It is part of Disney's plans for its 2027 business year, which began in October 2026. No launch date, price or countries were reported. Disney+ already offers a few such channels, like Disney princess and Pixar feeds, to paying subscribers.
where: Not announced; no date or countries reported
means: If you skipped Disney+ because of the price, a free way to watch some of it may come, but nothing is confirmed yet.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Disney hasn't confirmed the plan.
